plugins.name: auto-bmad
plugins.description: Drive the BMAD build lane end-to-end — bmad-build-auto plan -> build -> follow-up review per story, or an ENTIRE epic in one run (`/auto-bmad epic`) — with risk-gated TEA, epic-boundary gates + retrospective, one branch, a commit per phase, a PR and a report. Every step is delegated to a model-tuned host-native subagent on Claude Code, Codex, or opencode (or run inline where the host has no subagents).
